CustomField.label: Source Lead
CustomField.description: Null is the NORMAL shape for a competing broker's submission — only the winner's own row carries a Source Lead, since competing brokers no longer receive a Lead. Also null when a previously-linked Lead was deleted (SetNull). When populated, equal to Winning_Lead__c on the winning submission row.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The winner's own submission links to their Lead; a competing broker's submission has none (null is normal). Also null if a previously-linked Lead was deleted.
